CA.rationale: A processing-origin entry (command_estimate) is paired with the node's red content, linking processing condition to the content representation.

COD.rationale: Content (red), an organization/presentation pattern, and a separate origin/status are all explicitly present and bound to the same node/time.

A.rationale: A processing-origin label (command_estimate) is explicitly attached to the same node that lists its content, linking processing condition to that content's representation.

C.rationale: Multiple node lines explicitly identify represented content with attributes (red, blue) and coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origins/provenance entries are separately recorded from content lists for the same node, differentiating content identity from status/source.

O.rationale: Content is presented as explicit coordinate sets and a declared row/column orientation, describing how content is organized/presented.
